race.comment: THUNDEROUS (1) has the most reliable recent form, with placings at Warwick and Lismore before returning to a track where his record is notably strong. The Lismore third behind Toroness on soft ground was another solid piece of form, and Dylan Turner being back aboard adds to the case. On top. BRAVE HORATIUS (2) has a stronger profile than his first-up fifth at Toowoomba suggests, having been checked soon after the start in a Class 2, and he now gets an easier meeting with barrier one to help him improve. Key runner. CLAUDIO (9) brings the winning form after beating Introducing by just over five lengths at Tabulam, although this is harder than picnic company and barrier 13 asks more of him. ALMOND GOLD (7) looks to have the ability. Include.
